解蒙古大军之围。.en: The attacks on the towns have been repelled. Highbridge is under attack again.
解蒙古大军之围。.zh-CN: 各地的围攻已被击退，高桥城却再次告急。

en: Then it's a good thing I came to stop you.
zh-CN: 旅人，你已经无处可逃了。
幸好我是来拦住你的，不是来逃命的。

en: That's the last of them here. Please tell me the next stop has chairs.
A scout just brought word: Highbridge is under attack again.
Then we need to get back there.
We do, but go prepared. Train your companions and check their gear before returning. This will be a hard fight.
Right. Everyone ready before we set out.
zh-CN: 这里的敌人总算退了。下一站总该有把椅子吧？
探子刚送来消息：高桥城又遭到进攻了。
要回去，但得准备好。先培养伙伴、检查装备，再出发。这一战不会轻松。
明白。大家准备好了再走。
